name: KiWay Design Variant Workbench
description: Review, edit, validate, compare, audit, and release KiCad 10 design variants safely.
description_full: KiWay Design Variant Workbench provides semantic Set Default/rebase operations, a variant matrix, comparison and lint tables, PCB synchronization audits, guarded part substitutions, lifecycle management, and manufacturing-release generation. Every design-file write requires a preview, rejects active KiCad lock files and stale input hashes, validates generated S-expressions, creates all backups before writing, uses atomic replacement, and attempts rollback on failure. The IPC launcher detaches the workbench so KiCad can be closed before Apply.
